assertion: Only supported dense decoder-only structural families or explicit mappings are accepted
counterexample: string-only guessing accepts an unknown family
close_condition: two families plus explicit mapping pass and unknown fails

assertion: Embedding then complete ordered blocks then lm_head define logical layers
counterexample: parser splits block submodules or reorders layers
close_condition: full block modules remain indivisible and ordered

assertion: Misc trainable parameters attach to smaller adjacent side with front tie-break
counterexample: final norm is unowned or assigned by name accident
close_condition: final norm ownership matches byte rule

assertion: Tied embedding/head storage has exactly one owner at embedding and aliases are recorded
counterexample: shared weight appears in two payload owners
close_condition: tied fixture has one owner and duplicate fixture rejects

assertion: Every trainable parameter identity has exactly one owner
counterexample: unowned final norm or duplicated auxiliary parameter

assertion: Ambiguous structure fails closed unless explicit mapping is supplied
counterexample: unknown naming variation is guessed by layers substring
close_condition: unknown fails and third explicit variation passes

assertion: Logical registry provides complete unique parameter ownership for later fragment mapping
counterexample: tied or misc parameter coverage is not 100 percent
aggregation: covered unique identities over all trainable identities
close_condition: component evidence reports exact full coverage
